lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Uh... hi.
You look like you've got a lot of combat experience.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Do I?
Yeah. The way your gear's arranged is pretty different from the manual.
I'm guessing you've customized it to what works for you?

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: ... Yeah, that's right.
... Are you okay?

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: ... What?
You seem worn out.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: I've just gotten tired of this.
... I see.
They both grow silent as they sit in the swaying transport ship.
A short while later, the ship lands and the ramp door opens.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: I'll take the lead. Follow me.
Maria-n walks ahead, and the man follows.
He watches Maria-n from behind for a while.
Hold on.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: ... What is it?
Do we have to go this way?

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: ... Huh?
Is there a set route that we have to follow?

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Well... no. The destination is set, but the route isn't.
Then let's go this way.
The man takes Maria-n's arm and pulls.
There's no way a regular adult male could move a Nikke, but Maria-n doesn't resist and allows it to happen.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Wait, this is the complete opposite direction...
The man doesn't respond and continues to pull her along.
Maria-n follows him in a state of quiet resignation.
A short while later, the two arrive at a meadow thick with flowers.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Where are we...?
Wow, I had a feeling this would be here, but I wasn't sure.
Maria-n stares blankly at the field of flowers.
Then, a moment later, she shakes off the man's hand.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: How did you know there was a flower meadow here?

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: You must've been here before.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Tell me who you are.
There seems to be a misunderstanding... I just came this way because I smelled flowers...
Petals were drifting from this direction too.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: ... Okay, but why did you bring me here? What're you up to?
I just thought looking at some flowers might make you feel better.
I don't have any ulterior motive. Honestly.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: But why...?
Uh... because teamwork is important?
We're on the same mission anyway, and if either of us doesn't feel well, that's a risk for both of us.
So how do you feel? Any bett... wait, get down.
Maria-n ducks instinctively.
She looks toward where the man's eyes are fixed.
Three Raptures are walking slowly past.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: ... Hide behind cover. I'll take care of them.
Let's run.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: You want to run?
They haven't spotted us.
We can slip away without them noticing.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: But, we should fight and...
Why risk your life when you don't have to fight? Come on, let's go.
The man remains crouching as he starts moving away.
Maria-n follows him without thinking.
A short while later, the two slip out of the flower meadow and make their way back to the transport ship.
Phew. That was close.
Oh, here.
The man rummages in his chest pocket.
He holds out a single blue rose to Maria-n.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: ... What's this...?
A souvenir. Can't go to a flower meadow and not bring any flowers back.
Maria-n takes the flower.
She stares intently at the softly swaying petals.
... Feeling any better?

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: I think so.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Thank you.
Then let's get going. I think we might make a good team.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: ... Yeah. Same here.
*Rat-a-tat-tat-tat*

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: An ambush in a place like this...?!

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Keep your head down!
Will do!
The man crouches and hides behind cover, glancing around.
Something catches his eye under the cover next to him.
He turns his head and looks at Maria-n, who is locked in battle.
She's frantically firing at the enemy, and on her face he sees the fear of death.
The man moves quickly and dashes to the cover beside him.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Wait...!
He feels the hem of his jacket noticeably sway and hears a thud on the ground.
The man throws himself behind adjacent cover and picks up a grenade lying on the ground.
He pulls the pin and hurls it at the pack of Raptures who are still firing at them.
An explosion tears through the air with a resounding boom.
Maria-n pushes the attack on the scattered Raptures.
A short while later, the last remaining Rapture shudders and falls silent.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: *Huff... huff...!*

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: All clear.
Argh...!
Maria-n runs to the cover where the man is lying and checks his condition.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Show me where you're hurt!
I must've rolled too hard. My knee hurts.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Any major injuries?
A round grazed my jacket.
Whoa, look. The hem is torn to shreds. If that had hit me, it would've done more than open a little hole in my side.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: How could you be so reckless?! Do you think you have lives to spare...?!
And how many lives do you think you have?

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: ... What?
You were fighting so frantically, while clearly being afraid to die.
And yet you didn't even ask for help.
So I decided to help, because you looked like you were struggling.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Why?
Why...? Because I think that's what a commander is supposed to do.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: A commander...
I always dreamed of being a commander.
I spent a lot of time daydreaming about what I'd do when I became one.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Daydreaming can get you killed. It's not the same as actual combat.
Still, it worked out, didn't it? So we're all good.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: What's your name?
My name?

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Yeah. I've got to call you something, don't I?
Hmm... Good question.
Everyone calls me No. 7.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Then should I call you No. 7? It feels weird for me to call you that.
Yeah, I guess it kind of is.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: You said being a commander was your dream, right?
Yeah.
I made a promise with this one girl.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: A girl...? Who?
Hmm... Sorry, but I can't really remember.
But... she was really,
really important to me. I remember that much.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: ... I see.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Then I'll call you Commander.
No, that's... I mean...
I just graduated from the academy yesterday. It'd be embarrassing for you to call me Commander already.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: What does it matter? It's just the two of us.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: It should be fine, right?
... Yeah, okay. You can call me that.
And what should I call you?

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Oh, I'm...

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Maria-...

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Maria-n. You can call me Maria-n.
That's an unusual name. You don't normally enunciate the "n" separately.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: It's like a... serial number.
Seriously? That's practically like calling me No. 7, then.
Marian.
I'll just call you Marian. Not bad, right?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Marian.
Yeah.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Yeah. Please call me that.
Good. Ready to get back to it, Marian?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... Yeah, Commander.
Oh, before we do.
The man crouches down in front of Marian.
He rummages through his things and pulls out a bandage.
He wraps it carefully around Marian's ankle.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: What... are you doing?
Treating your wound.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: A bandage isn't of much use to a Nikke.
Don't be so sure. It'll help heal your heart.
There. All done. It won't get in the way when you move, will it?
Suddenly, they hear a low hum.
The Rapture that fell silent moments ago begins to vibrate.
They both lock their eyes on the Rapture.
It lets out a thunderous roar and immediately charges at them.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: What the...?! It's going to self-destruct!
Hngh...!
The man shoves Marian, who tumbles over the cover.
The Rapture continues to vibrate as it rushes forward. The man plants his hands on the cover and vaults over it.
*Kaboom!*
The Rapture explodes.
Marian ducks behind the cover.
A moment later the smoke clears and she rises.
She crosses the cover and looks around.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... Commander?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Commander! Where are you?
*Squelch*
Marian steps on something.
She looks down, standing motionless with a vacant expression on her face.
The man has disappeared, leaving only small pieces behind.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... Ahhh...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... Ahhhhh...!

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: No. 7:

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Died in an explosion while attempting to shield the Maria-model Nikke he was accompanying.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: The Maria-model Nikke subsequently experienced severe emotional disruption and continued the mission alone.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Corruption manifested at the 48.2% mark.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Twenty hours later, a Queen Gene was detected near the Lift before disappearing.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: No. 7's companionship appears to have had a significant impact on both their progress and the Queen Gene's appearance.
Marian opens her eyes, devastated.
She goes downstairs and finds Doctor Maria.
She wants to tell Doctor Maria how she feels,
but when she sees those eyes looking at her like an object, as they always do, she swallows both her words and her feelings.
Marian walks with her eyes to the ground,
receives the enhancement procedure and boards the transport ship.
She looks at the man seated across from her.
The man gives her a slight smile.
Hi, Marian.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Plans to create No. 8 have been canceled.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: No. 7 will be deployed repeatedly.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Ohhh...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Hah... Haha...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Hahaha... Haha...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Hahahaha...
MARIA-n: To Be Continued...
